name: Transforming the Customer Experience Through Sensory Marketing
summary: You will support a character named Maria. She is a budding entrepreneur and wants to open a new café in Madrid. The establishment will sell bread, simple sandwiches, pastries, cakes and beverages, both to go and to enjoy in the spacious seating area. Maria is hiring the student as an expert in these psychological principles to help her make the right decisions according to what she wants her customers´ experience to be like.
